name: fit a polynomial matching both values and derivatives at the points
mechanism: raise the degree so that at each sample the polynomial matches not only the value but also the first few derivatives; each matched derivative is one more linear condition on the coefficients

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Hermite interpolation' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Interpolation and extrapolation:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Birkhoff interpolation': an extension of polynomial interpolation

fails_when: needs derivatives that measured data rarely provides
